# RIPE (Realizing Increased Photosynthetic Efficiency)

> RIPE is a Gates Foundation-funded research initiative at the University of Illinois engineering photosynthetic efficiency in staple crops like cassava, cowpea, and maize to enhance global food security.

RIPE combines computational modeling, synthetic biology, and crop transformation to optimize photosynthesis through multiple biological pathways. The project partners with international institutions including Lancaster University and operates specialized research facilities for phenotyping and genetic transformation.

## Key Topics

- Photosynthesis efficiency
- Rubisco engineering
- Cassava and cowpea crops
- Photorespiration
- Non-photochemical quenching (NPQ)
- RuBP regeneration
- Canopy optimization
- Crop bioengineering
- Plant biotechnology
- Food security
- Synthetic metabolism
- Mesophyll conductance
- High-throughput phenotyping
- Gates Foundation funding
- Staple crop improvement

## Research Infrastructure & Facilities

- [Our Facilities](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/our-facilities): RIPE research infrastructure: Crop Transformation and High-Throughput Phenotyping

## Photosynthesis Research Areas

- [Improving Rubisco](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/improving-rubisco): Rubisco regulation and gene editing in cowpea and soybean with Lancaster University
- [Photorespiratory Bypass](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/photorespiratory-bypass): Rubisco engineering and synthetic metabolism in cowpeas, soybeans, and rice
- [Relaxing Photoprotection](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/relaxing-photoprotection): Non-photochemical quenching (NPQ) optimization for improved crop photosynthesis
- [RuBP Regeneration](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/rubp-regeneration): Ribulose biphosphate regeneration for enhanced carbon fixation efficiency
- [Improving Leaf Conductance](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/improving-leaf-conductance): Stomatal and mesophyll conductance optimization in soybean and cowpea
- [Optimizing Canopies](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/optimizing-canopies): Canopy architecture optimization for improved light distribution and photosynthesis
- [Algal Mechanisms](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/algal-mechanisms): Cyanobacteria carboxysomes and Rubisco engineering for crop improvement

## Computational & Translational Research

- [Modeling Photosynthesis](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/modeling-photosynthesis): Computational modeling and simulation of photosynthesis efficiency with Yu Wang
- [Advancing Translation](https://ripe.illinois.edu/objectives/advancing-translation): Translating photosynthesis improvements to cassava and tobacco for global food security
